root_cause: Strict mode violations in Playwright occur because the locators `page.get_by_role("link", name="Contact")` and `page.get_by_text("Python")` match multiple elements on the page. Specifically, 'Contact' matches both the navbar link and the 'Contact Me' button/link, and 'Python' matches multiple skill tag elements as well as text in the skill section.
suggested_fix: Refine the locators to be unique or use `.first` / specify exact matching or scope them appropriately (e.g., using `exact=True` for the contact link or scoping the Python text check to the skills section).

patches.reason: Avoid strict mode violation by using exact=True so it doesn't match 'Contact Me'.
Scope the Python text check to the skills section and use .first or specific locator to avoid matching multiple elements.
